question: Town M is to the east of Town N. Town O is to the south of Town M. Town P is to the west of Town O. Town Q is to the north of Town P. Town N is to the north-west of Town Q. What is the location of Town M with respect to Town Q?
solution:
Given:

Town M is to the east of Town N.

Town O is to the south of Town M.

Town P is to the west of Town O.

Town Q is to the north of Town P.

Town N is to the north-west of Town Q
